Full ligature proof sheet

From concept to font

The flowing ec and in, nested na and oo, and coordinated rt were redrawn as original vector outlines and reviewed in compiled text. AI sketches helped explore gestures; every active shape belongs to the font. Identity-changing treatments such as nn resembling m still require consultation unless full creative freedom was explicitly granted.

na / in / ec concepts · oo / rt concepts

Reference

Original outlines inspired by the supplied lettering. Optional ligatures develop its connected rhythm; turning them off restores the separate letterforms.
